name: What does garage finish carpentry include?

mainEntity.name: What does garage finish carpentry include?

acceptedAnswer.text: Garage finish carpentry includes the decorative and functional woodwork installed after framing, insulation, and drywall are complete. Common elements include custom baseboards, window and door casings, built-in storage cabinets, durable workbenches, utility shelving, and wall coverings like wainscoting or trim detailing. Because garages experience seasonal humidity and temperature shifts, material selection is a major decision factor. Finish carpenters often recommend moisture-resistant trim materials, such as exterior-grade composite trims or properly sealed solid woods, to ensure clean lines and long-term durability along concrete garage slabs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Garage finish carpentry includes installing custom baseboards, door and window trim, durable shelving, workbenches, and built-in cabinets after framing and drywall are complete.
